description: Consumer Affairs Authority - The Consumer Affairs Authority here by Rescind Order No. 88 Amended Extraordinary Gaz. No. 2356/39 Dated 03.11.2023
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the rescission of a previous order (Order No. 88) under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003 (Amended). It involves a regulatory action by a statutory authority, specifically modifying the legal framework. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (new laws, acts, regulations, amendments, repeals, or modifications), not government personnel or structural changes.
